name: Honda E0–E6
summary: The first, secret phase of Honda's humanoid program: a series of legs-only experimental robots. E0 (1986) walked statically, taking up to 20 seconds per step; by E6 (1993) the line could balance dynamically, climb stairs and walk on slopes and uneven ground. The E-series worked out the walking control that P2 and ASIMO would inherit.
notable: Progression from 20-second static steps to dynamic stair climbing in seven years
